topics.name: Phenibut
topics.focus: Regional controlled anxiety/sleep evidence versus historical uncontrolled claims; racemate/enantiomers and FAA/HCl; GABA-B/alpha2delta species-specific mechanisms; original PK estimates; dependence, withdrawal and poison-center harms.

topics.name: Tadalafil
topics.focus: Official indication-specific labels and RCTs: erectile function (IIEF), LUTS/BPH (IPSS), PAH (6-minute walk/clinical worsening); distinguish healthy exercise claims. PDE5/cGMP; CYP3A4/renal/hepatic PK; nitrates/riociguat and hypotension; pivotal-trial sponsorship.

topics.name: Astaxanthin
topics.focus: Natural versus synthetic/isomer/ester/oil formulations; controlled skin, visual fatigue, exercise, cognition and lipid studies; biomarkers versus clinical endpoints; null results; manufacturer involvement and registered-trial overlap.

topics.name: Zeaxanthin
topics.focus: Zeaxanthin versus meso-zeaxanthin and lutein; macular pigment, visual performance and AMD outcomes; isolate effects from AREDS2 mixtures; deficiency versus healthy supplementation; formulation/absorption and commercial disclosures.

topics.name: Lactoferrin
topics.focus: Bovine versus human lactoferrin, apo/holo and formulation; oral human RCTs for iron/anemia, respiratory infection and gut outcomes; biomarker versus clinical benefit; pediatric populations separate; milk allergy; industry sponsorship.

topics.name: Magnesium
topics.focus: Elemental magnesium overview: deficiency/repletion, clinical indications and evidence for sleep, BP, glycemic and cognitive outcomes. Distinguish salts and formulation studies without treating forms as interchangeable; NIH/EFSA safety, renal risks, medication binding; no single-drug half-life.

topics.name: Synbiotics
topics.focus: Define synbiotic product and strains/prebiotic substrate; complementary versus synergistic claims; strain/product-specific controlled GI, infection and metabolic outcomes; avoid extrapolating between products; immunocompromised risks; sponsor and protocol registration.

topics.name: Saccharomyces boulardii
topics.focus: Organism and strain-specific probiotic evidence, especially CNCM I-745; antibiotic-associated/traveler diarrhea and recurrent C difficile contexts; effect estimates, comparators, absolute-risk contexts; fungemia and central-line/immunocompromised risks; antifungal interactions.

topics.name: Bromelain
topics.focus: Stem versus fruit enzyme mixtures and proteolytic activity units versus mg; primary human pain, postoperative swelling and sinus/GI trials; isolate from combinations; bioavailability/mechanism limits; allergy/bleeding/interactions evidence versus theory.

topics.name: Urolithin A
topics.focus: Urolithin A versus dietary ellagitannins and microbiome producers; controlled human muscle function/endurance and mitochondrial biomarkers, primary versus secondary/null endpoints; Mitopure product specifics; PK; manufacturer funding, employee/patent interests and overlapping cohorts.

topics.name: Liver
topics.focus: Liver as food and desiccated liver supplement evidence; nutrient composition/bioavailability and anemia claims; no invented single molecule; actual nutrient amounts distinguish species/preparation; vitamin A/copper excess, pregnancy context and contaminant/product uncertainties; direct trials versus nutrient inference.

topics.name: Vitamin C
topics.focus: Ascorbic acid/formulations, deficiency correction versus additional supplementation; controlled common-cold duration/incidence, exercise stress and cardiometabolic findings; oral versus IV separated; saturable absorption/renal handling; kidney stones/iron overload and lab/drug interference.

topics.name: Choline
topics.focus: Choline nutrient overview, deficiency/adequate intake and clinical outcomes; distinguish dietary choline, salts, phosphatidylcholine, citicoline and alpha-GPC; cognition versus hepatic biomarkers, TMAO association versus causality, pregnancy evidence and safety.

topics.name: Choline bitartrate
topics.focus: Salt and actual elemental choline fraction; controlled healthy-person cognitive/attention trials, null findings and distinction from other forms; choline/TMAO biomarker studies; dose/exposure/formulation; no borrowed citicoline efficacy.

topics.name: Choline chloride
topics.focus: Salt-specific nutrient/clinical human evidence and actual choline amount; deficiency/repletion and parenteral versus oral contexts; cognition evidence gaps; do not borrow outcomes from different choline forms; safety and absorption.

topics.name: Phosphatidylcholine
topics.focus: Lipid mixture, phospholipid species/lecithin versus purified product; controlled hepatic/cognitive evidence, negative trials and formulation specificity; oral absorption/TMAO biology, clinical inference limits; no single CID or universal half-life for mixtures.

topics.name: Citicoline
topics.focus: CDP-choline versus dietary choline; major stroke and brain-injury negative RCTs plus cognition trials and exact populations; preserve existing sources/data, primary/secondary endpoints and formulations; PK/metabolites; industry funding and patents.

topics.name: Alpha-GPC
topics.focus: L-alpha-glycerylphosphorylcholine formulation and purity; cognition in impairment versus healthy-person exercise/attention claims; controlled RCTs and nulls; observational stroke association with confounding distinguished from causal harm; absorption, interactions and manufacturer interests.

topics.name: Phenylpiracetam
topics.focus: Fonturacetam/Phenotropil names and stereochemistry; original Russian controlled clinical research versus healthy enhancement claims; regional reporting/translation limits; PK and dopaminergic mechanism species; adverse events and official sport/regulatory context.

topics.name: Noopept
topics.focus: Omberacetam regional clinical trials versus uncontrolled/preclinical claims; patient populations and comparators; memory/anxiety endpoints, exact instruments and null evidence; peptide/metabolite claims and species; missing robust human PK; manufacturer sponsorship.

topics.name: GABA
topics.focus: Oral GABA supplement only, distinct from endogenous transmitter and phenibut; controlled stress/sleep studies and instruments; BBB penetration uncertainty and peripheral mechanisms; fermented versus synthetic product; PK versus effect duration; manufacturer funding.

topics.name: L-tyrosine
topics.focus: L-tyrosine versus N-acetyl-L-tyrosine; controlled cognition/working-memory under cold/stress/sleep deprivation versus rested healthy subjects; amino-acid competition and catecholamine precursor mechanism without dopamine-benefit inference; interaction and dose-context evidence.

topics.name: Atomoxetine
topics.focus: Strattera generic identity; ADHD RCT/label clinical outcomes versus healthy cognition; onset of clinical response separate from plasma half-life; CYP2D6 genotype/inhibitors, hepatic factors; suicidality/hepatic/cardiovascular warnings and MAOI interactions; sponsor COI.

topics.name: Berberine
topics.focus: Correct Betberine alias; salts/formulation and primary metabolic RCTs for glycemia/lipids/weight; trial quality and publication bias, comparators and endpoints; distinguish AMPK/preclinical claims; low oral availability/metabolites; pregnancy/GI/drug metabolism interactions.

topics.name: Fasting
topics.focus: One fasting protocol family: distinguish time-restricted eating, alternate-day and prolonged fasting with exact windows and comparator calories. Controlled human weight/glycemic/BP outcomes versus calorie restriction; adherence, lean mass, sex/population contexts; autophagy/longevity claims not clinical proof; risks.

topics.name: Ketogenic diet
topics.focus: Exact ketogenic diet carbohydrate/fat/protein definition, energy intake and ketosis measure; epilepsy indications versus weight/diabetes/cognition and healthy enhancement; RCT endpoints/nulls/comparators; lipid/LDL heterogeneity, nutrient/GI risks and glucose-lowering drug interactions.

topics.name: Exogenous ketones
topics.focus: Ketone salts versus ketone monoester and D/L beta-hydroxybutyrate; product-specific human exercise/cognition/glycemic trials including nulls; ketosis biomarker not clinical benefit; PK/analyte, sodium/mineral/GI burden; sponsor patents and industry ties.

topics.name: Modafinil
topics.focus: Preserve existing source-grounded records; approved narcolepsy/OSA/shift-work disorder versus rested healthy cognition; objective wake/attention tasks and subjective alertness; label PK/CYP interactions, hormonal contraception and rash/cardiovascular/psychiatric warnings; sponsor COI.

topics.name: Armodafinil
topics.focus: R-modafinil versus racemic modafinil, Nuvigil official labels and controlled wakefulness trials; do not borrow estimates across enantiomers; indication/patient versus healthy cognitive claims; PK late exposure, interactions and severe rash/psychiatric risks; sponsorship.

topics.name: Quercetin
topics.focus: Normalize Quercetine alias; aglycone/glycoside/phytosome formulations; primary human respiratory/exercise/BP/metabolic trials, inconsistent/null findings; oxidative biomarkers not benefit; formulation PK and clinical interaction evidence versus enzyme-tube studies; sponsored combinations.

topics.name: Lutein
topics.focus: Lutein-specific versus lutein/zeaxanthin combinations; controlled visual/macular pigment and AMD endpoints with population/AREDS2 distinctions; cognition secondary evidence; source/formulation/absorption; exact dose context and commercial funding.

topics.name: Lutemax
topics.focus: One branded carotenoid mixture topic: distinguish Lutemax 2020/other formulations and lutein/zeaxanthin/meso ratios; exact-product human visual/cognitive/sleep trials, primary versus secondary endpoints/nulls and repeated cohorts; OmniActive/manufacturer/employee/patent COI.

topics.name: PQQ
topics.focus: Pyrroloquinoline quinone disodium and product identity; controlled human cognition/fatigue trials versus mitochondrial cell/animal claims; small samples and sponsor interests; safety/PK human evidence and regulatory evaluations; no unsupported mitochondrial count/longevity claims.

topics.name: Spermidine
topics.focus: Normalize Spermedine alias; dietary spermidine versus enriched wheat-germ extracts and combination doses; placebo-controlled cognition/memory trials including negative SMARTAGE findings; observational diet/longevity associations separate from interventions; autophagy species and sponsor/COI.

topics.name: Magnesium citrate
topics.focus: This form only: elemental amount versus citrate mass, oral bioavailability compared with oxide and documented GI/laxative uses; distinguish comparative absorption from clinical sleep/cognition proof; renal risk and medication binding; no borrowed threonate evidence.

topics.name: Magnesium glycinate
topics.focus: Bisglycinate identity and buffered products versus pure chelate, actual elemental dose; direct controlled sleep/cognition/deficiency trials and absence thereof; glycine coingredient not proven form advantage; comparative absorption and tolerance; manufacturer disclosure.

topics.name: Magnesium oxide
topics.focus: Form-specific absorption and elemental dose; constipation/migraine/deficiency controlled contexts and actual outcomes; lower absorption versus clinical adequacy distinction, laxative endpoint; renal hypermagnesemia risks; no generalized sleep benefit from other salts.

topics.name: Magnesium malate
topics.focus: Malate salt and actual elemental magnesium; direct human fibromyalgia/pain/energy trials including combination-product attribution limits; no efficacy inferred from Krebs-cycle mechanism; absorption/form comparisons and evidence gaps; safety.

topics.name: Magnesium L-threonate
topics.focus: Magtein/threonate form, salt versus elemental dose; original controlled cognition/sleep trials, endpoint instruments, primary/secondary/nulls and combined formulations; animal brain-Mg claims versus human clinical evidence; manufacturer patents/funding and actual PK.

topics.name: Magnesium taurate
topics.focus: This magnesium/taurine salt only; direct human trials and evidence gaps for BP/cardiac/sleep claims; do not attribute separate taurine or generic magnesium findings to salt; elemental content, salt identity, safety and interaction evidence.

topics.name: Magnesium chloride
topics.focus: Oral versus IV versus topical/oil uses separated, elemental amount; direct human correction/metabolic trials and clinical endpoints; critically assess transdermal absorption claims; renal/electrolyte/GI risks and official sources.

topics.name: Magnesium sulfate
topics.focus: Epsom salt and IV medication contexts separated; official obstetric/eclampsia and acute care evidence versus unsupported bath/transdermal biohacking claims; elemental versus salt mass, route-specific PK and toxicity; no home IV/dosing regimen.

topics.name: Huperzine A
topics.focus: Purified Huperzine A versus Huperzia extracts, stereochemistry; controlled Alzheimer/cognition trials including inconsistent/negative primary endpoints; healthy enhancement gaps; cholinesterase inhibition, PK and cholinergic adverse events/interactions; funding and risk of bias.

topics.name: Phosphatidylserine
topics.focus: Soy/sunflower versus historical bovine cortex preparations; dementia/healthy cognition/stress/exercise RCTs and null findings; different mixtures/formulations not interchangeable; cortisol biomarker versus experienced benefit; product-specific sponsorship and safety.

topics.name: Resveratrol
topics.focus: Trans/cis and formulation; human metabolic/cognition/vascular trial effects and nulls, surrogate endpoints versus clinical benefit; oral metabolism/bioavailability; animal longevity claims not human proof; high-dose/GI/interaction evidence; sponsor interests.

topics.name: Melatonin
topics.focus: Preserve existing records; circadian phase/delayed sleep phase versus nonspecific insomnia and healthy sleep; IR/PR and timing/light context; actual sleep endpoints/effect estimates, phase response versus elimination; CYP1A2 modifiers, product-content variability and safety.

topics.name: Dihexa
topics.focus: Chemical identity and preclinical-only HGF/c-Met/cognition research; explicitly search human trials/PK and report absence when verified; no clinical efficacy/dose recommendations from rodents; mechanistic tumor-risk concern versus observed human harm; patents/authors and COI.

topics.name: Psilocybin microdosing
topics.focus: Microdosing only, explicitly defined dose range in each study; controlled placebo/blinding/expectancy RCTs, null cognitive/mood outcomes versus uncontrolled anecdotes; do not borrow macrodose depression data; active psilocin PK versus repeated protocol timing; cardiac/psychiatric uncertainties and law.

topics.name: LSD microdosing
topics.focus: Microdosing only with exact study definition; placebo-controlled repeated/acute cognition/mood findings and null results; blinding/expectancy, healthy populations and instruments; LSD analyte PK, repeated-use uncertainty/valvular theory distinct from demonstrated harm; no home regimen.

topics.name: Amphetamine
topics.focus: Generic amphetamine overview with d/l stereoisomers distinguished; clinical ADHD/narcolepsy evidence versus healthy enhancement; DAT/NET and source-supported mechanism graph, subjective versus measured outcomes; route/formulation PK; abuse/dependence/cardiovascular/psychiatric/MAOI risks.

topics.name: Lisdexamfetamine
topics.focus: Vyvanse/Elvanse prodrug only, not mg-equivalent to d-amphetamine; official ADHD/binge-eating label contexts and trial endpoints; preserve existing identity; parent versus active d-amphetamine PK/red-cell conversion, durations not half-life; controlled risks and sponsor COI.

topics.name: Mixed amphetamine salts
topics.focus: Adderall only, exact mixed salts/d:l formulation and IR versus XR; primary ADHD outcome trials/official labels; product dose not pure base equivalent; formulation timing/active analyte half-life, variability; healthy enhancement gaps, dependence/contraindications and sponsor disclosures.

topics.name: Dextroamphetamine
topics.focus: Dexedrine/Zenzedi d-amphetamine only; IR/extended formulations, base versus sulfate mass; official indication and primary human outcome data; separate healthy cognition and subjective stimulant effects; source-specific PK/timing and serious risks/interactions.

topics.name: Bromantane
topics.focus: Ladasten/бромантан regional controlled asthenia studies versus healthy biohacking claims; clinical instruments/design/translation limits; mechanistic dopaminergic transcription and species; original PK rather than repeated online values; adverse data limits, official sport/regulatory sources and manufacturer COI.

topics.name: Omega-3
topics.focus: EPA/DHA formulations, dose of active EPA/DHA versus fish-oil mass; primary clinical cardiovascular/depression/cognitive RCTs and nulls, prescription EPA versus general oils; triglyceride biomarker versus events, AF/bleeding risks and sponsor COI.

topics.name: Vitamin D
topics.focus: D3/D2 and deficiency/repletion versus routine high-dose supplementation in replete people; primary skeletal/falls/infection/mood/cardiovascular outcomes including large negative trials; calcium coadministration, 25-OH metabolite measurement, hypercalcemia and sponsor disclosures.

topics.name: Coenzyme Q10
topics.focus: Ubiquinone versus ubiquinol formulations; heart-failure/migraine/statin-symptom controlled outcomes and evidence quality/nulls; absorption, placebo/comparator, actual study populations; drug interactions and manufacturer sponsorship, no generalized energy guarantee.

topics.name: Glycine
topics.focus: Oral glycine supplement evidence for sleep and metabolic endpoints, small crossover trials and nulls; clinical measures versus subjective sleep ratings; amino-acid mechanisms/species, actual study exposures/PK and safety; sponsor/COI.

topics.name: Taurine
topics.focus: Oral taurine human BP/metabolic/exercise RCTs and nulls versus animal aging/longevity claims; exact endpoint instruments/estimates/populations; energy drink mixtures not isolated taurine evidence; absorption/renal handling, risks and sponsor/COI.
